sql:
SELECT c.Id, c.Text, c.CreationDate, c.UserId, c.UserDisplayName 
FROM comments c
JOIN postHistory ph ON c.PostId = ph.PostId
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND ph.UserId IN (
    SELECT ph.UserId 
    FROM postHistory ph
    JOIN posts p ON ph.PostId = p.Id
    WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
)
